Hypothetical institutions, purely abstract principles, and personal anecdotes that are not institutional do not qualify. Evidence need not be externally verified. Ignore any text reporting the OP's view change, delta awards, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates or whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement. right_definition: Counter-argument comments by other users (OC_comments): 1 if any comment employs a specific, verifiable procedural example (a concrete named or checkable process, rule, procedure or documented case of how something is actually done) as part of its rebuttal, else 0

Return 0 if comments are assessable and none do so, i.e. rebuttals rely on abstract/theoretical reasoning, generic claims, invented hypotheticals, or vague gestures without a specific procedural example. Quoted text from others counts only if the commenter uses it as their own example. Ignore any OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the outcome occurred; generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not an outcome announcement and remains eligible. Use current supplied text; do not infer timing or order (list order carries no meaning). Empty valid list: return 0. Missing or malformed OC_comments: return null. Output a single 0/1 or null.
